newsitem.title: USA: ROWAN'S LETOURNEAU SELLS DRILLING RIG KIT.
newsitem.headline: ROWAN'S LETOURNEAU SELLS DRILLING RIG KIT.

text.p: LeTourneau Inc said it will provide a LeTourneau kit consisting of vessel design, the rig's legs, jacking system, cranes and certain other components for a Super 116 Class jack-up drilling rig to be built by AMFELS Inc of Brownsville, Texas, for Chiles Offshore.

The kit will be delivered in stages over the last half of 1998 in accordance with the construction schedule. With this sale, six of the seven new jack-ups currently scheduled for construction are of LeTourneau design, the Rowan Cos Inc subsidiary said.
